RERUN 2026-09-25 under the cases-are-one-example rule; each multi-case example carries one description/state/TRL and every other row starts with its [case] label (the earlier process labels, verbatim). Main file: (1) anaerobic-digester_biogas - AD system alone: Figure 1 as one example with two feed-mix cases (capex and capacity ranges from the labelled bars), a generic process from the text (lifetime 15-20 yr economic, process energy 15% of biogas as GJ/GJ, 'converts 30-60% of the input'), and the Table 5 Grass-to-Gas digester (annual output, volume, silage flow). (2) anaerobic-digester_biomethane - AD with upgrader: description and capacity only; its capex is NOT recorded because Figure 2 prints only segments - the build assembles it from the Figure 1 digester and Figure 2 upgrader rows (whole-plant-assembly.csv). (3) separator_biogas - generic upgrader, Figure 2 upgrader segments. (4) Table 6 five upgrading technologies (separator_biogas_water-scrubbing, _amine-scrubbing, _pressure-swing-adsorption, _membrane, _organic-scrubbing), each ONE example 'Biogas upgrading (Table 6)' with three cases: [<500 m3/h raw gas] (capex), [500-2000 m3/h raw gas] (capex) and [all sizes] (availability, electricity-only specific energy consumption - for amine DERIVED as printed electricity + heat - CH4 slip as emissions-process ch4 in % of throughput, electricity and amine-heat flows). All upgrader costs are per m3/h of RAW BIOGAS treated (service unit m3 raw gas), recorded as product-output. (5) Table 2 UASB and fixed-film digesters: description only (no numbers). (6) process-improvement_landfill-gas: one example with four cover-type cases, with capture-rate target ch4 (35/65/85/90%). (7) reciprocating-engine_landfill-gas: IPCC 2003 USD/kW capex DERIVED as the sum of four printed components (components in the sidecar) and Table 10 landfill ~5 MW (capacity, capex). (8) reciprocating-engine_biogas_chp: Table 5 500 kWe digester-CHP (capacity, annual electricity and heat, derived capacity factor and heat-to-power ratio) and Table 10 AD ~1 MW (capacity, capex). (9) gasifier_biomass_methanation: equipment capex USD/kW, cold gas efficiency 65-80%+, and the Worley and Yale 1000 dry t/d plant (capacity, total capex, derived capex per ft3/d, derived wood-per-gas flow). O&M given as % of investment has no parameter: it is in the capex notes and the _costs-and-prices sidecar. Sidecars (not loaded): _feedstock-yields (Tables 4, 7, 10 yield blocks and text yields; defects flagged), _costs-and-prices (levelized/production costs, LCOE, O&M shares, incremental CHP +25%, landfill USD 6/m3 with no denominator, projections, domestic digesters - residential), _summary-restatements (Table 10 AD and upgrader rows under the wrong USD/kW heading), _context (Tables 1, 2, 3, 8, 9 life-cycle factors, market and gasifier-scale figures, product CH4 purity). AD and upgrader nodes are in m3 (raw biogas); converting to the archetype GJ needs a biogas energy content that the same example does not give (Table 1's generic 6.5 kWh/Nm3 is not example-specific).

(1) Table 10 cost block heads its investment column 'Investment Cost (USD/kW)', but the Anaerobic digester and Upgrader rows are per m3/h of raw gas (text p.5-6, Table 6, Figures 1-2). (2) Table 10 'Energy use (kWh/m3 raw gas)' column holds 'Up to 15%' for the digester - a percentage of biogas energy. (3) Table 10 AD capex (4875-7312 <500 m3/h; 5265-5850 500-2000 m3/h) does not match Figure 1 (7500 at 250 Nm3/h; ~6,700 at 500 Nm3/h) or the text (5000-7500). (4) Table 10 upgrader energy '0.18-0.7' - Table 6's lowest value is 0.12 (amine electricity). (5) Figure 2: the 250 Nm3/h maize bar's upgrader label 5950 does not match the drawn segment (~5,200; bar top ~12,700 vs 13,450 by labels); the other three labelled bars match their drawn tops. (6) Currency year of Figures 1-2 (2012 USD) appears only on the chart axes; Table 6, Table 10 and most text costs state no year. (7) Table 5: 'Potential biogas production 2.54 Nm3/yr' is missing a multiplier (millions); 'Electricity produced 4,140 MWh/hr' should be MWh/yr. (8) Table 4: '1 cattle (beef) (3 to 11 t solid manure/yr)' is identical to the pig row (42-168 Nm3/yr) - a copied cell. (9) Table 10 yields: pig slurry 'CH4 in biogas 65 (70-80)' - value outside its own range; the 'BxC/D' column fails its own formula for leaves (274 vs 410-450), grass (412 vs 350), maize (441 vs 370) and straw; the crop block's 'AxBxC' fails for maize (1,753-12,825 vs 4660-12150). (10) Table 10 'Collected landfill gas 6.9-1.8' is printed high-to-low, and its USD/GJ and cents/m3 ranges are not in a constant ratio. (11) Table 8 World column headed 'PJ' holds EJ values (23, 13, 36; 532 primary energy). (12) Table 1 natural-gas CO2 '0.7-1' and N2 '0-14' lack their '%'. (13) 'USD 6/m3' landfill collection-and-flaring cost (US EPA 2012) states no denominator. (14) Gasification 'USD 2000 and 6000/kW equivalent' does not say kW of what, and 'in constant currency' names no year. (15) p.9 'The United States produced 9.1 GWh of electricity from biogas in 2012' is implausibly small (probably TWh). (16) Typos: 'oxigen', 'sillage', 'Volatil', 'lignocellulostic', 'a cells'.
